articles.title: Plume affiliate lands broker-dealer license to bring real U.S. assets onchain
articles.snippet: Kimber Digital Securities secured SEC and Finra approvals, a regulatory milestone paving the way for the delivery of legally binding claims, dividends, and yield-bearing products directly to self-custodial wallets and stablecoin applications in the U.S.

articles.title: Ripple Prime head Marc Asch to step down, Noel Kimmel named successor
articles.snippet: Asch is stepping down as head of the institutional prime brokerage.

articles.title: Bitcoin breaks with stocks, declines as ETF outflows mount, MARA reduces holdings
Robinhood backs tokenization of its stock on OKX–ICE platform even as most companies opt out
articles.snippet: The brokerage firm said it would rather help build tokenized markets than sit on the sidelines, following a wave of early corporate pushback to the Intercontinental Exchange and OKX joint venture.

articles.title: Kimber Digital Securities gains broker-dealer status for tokenized assets
articles.snippet: The Plume affiliate plans to offer tokenized US stocks, ETFs and bonds through self-custodial wallets, with traditional shareholder rights preserved.
